capabilities: Fetch a web page and strip ads, navigation, and clutter
Convert extracted article content to markdown
Save the result as a new note with frontmatter (title, source, author, published, description)
Insert parsed content at the cursor in the active note
Configure the folder for new notes and when to be asked where to save
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to fetch a web page and save just the article content as readable markdown without ads and navigation clutter.

relations.evidence: the extraction library this plugin is built on

summary: Web clipper that parses a URL with the Defuddle library into clean markdown and saves it as a new note or inserts it at the cursor.
